limits: Synthetic V0 is not an existing application format; fields are candidate domain contract
Hashes/IDs prove generated byte equality only, not real source identity or security
Exception injection differs from actual owned os._exit; neither is power failure/disk full
Local fsync/rename/package/SQLite do not prove any cloud/provider/two-machine coherence
Serial reconciliation/dependency guards are not concurrency or native app-job guarantees
Recorded cuts/map evidence do not validate protected speech/DSP/actual exports
Marker relink is not bookmark/TCC/security scope/hydration/cross-machine validation
Representation/project timings were traced; standalone JSON library timing was untraced; neither is a macOS26/16GB/device/performance guarantee
Author-role review is not independent reproduction; finite coverage not universal
Truncated SQLite header fallback tested through existing adapter/fresh connection; new adapter construction can fail before fallback
Relative/absolute hints retained; no general automatic hint resolver exercised
Five negative controls are simulations/simple inequalities, not unsafe implementation runs
Repeated injections vary paths but repeat substantive payloads; not statistical independence
Complete history/cursor/primary-transition validation and newer library behavior unestablished

resource_observations.first_vs_warm: First read is first per newly saved show in this pass, already likely OS-cached by write; not uncached hardware. Warm denominator200 is two distinct passes over100 shows. Nearest-rank p95 ceil(.95*n), no performance gate.
resource_observations.timing_scope: Serialization includes candidate validation; save includes encoding, filesystem/SQL transaction and fsync. Read includes disk bytes/SQL rows, integrity checks, typed hydration, semantic validation; excludes subsequent truth equality. SQLite open/PRAGMAs included. Tracemalloc enabled for representation/project timed samples, including representation-library save/load. Standalone JSON canonical-library load/validation sample (library_load_validate_ms) runs after tracemalloc.stop() and is untraced; traced allocation peak/end exclude it.
